text: You foolish scaly little brats! I never thought\nyou'd be dumb enough to walk right into the\npirates' hideout!
Bwahahaha! Your flesh and blood will make up for\nall the nutrients I've lost over the last 300\nyears!
Once I'm stuffed, it's time to set sail!!
I won't let you do that!
Bwahaha?! Who are you?! Show yourself!
Ouchhh!!\nWhat do you think you're doing, you lil' brat!!
Akula! You stay back!\nWe'll turn this thing into shark fin soup!
H-how dare pathetic scaly creatures like you...\nUgh!!
